2607.27990.title: Driving up Inference Energy on SNNs: Per-Sample and Universal Sponge Attacks
2607.27990.paper_summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spike events rather than dense activations, enabling energy-efficient inference on neuromorphic hardware and motivating their use in always-on, battery-powered edge systems. We show that this same efficiency advantage creates a distinct security risk: sponge attacks can increase inference-time spike activity and synaptic workload, inflating energy consumption while remaining difficult to detect through correctness-based monitoring alone. Prior input-space efficiency attacks on SNNs have focused on per-sample optimization, primarily in rate-coded settings. We extend this threat to native event-based binary inputs and study two attack models. First, we develop a per-sample sponge attack that crafts a custom adversarial spike train for each input via gradient-based optimization. This attack increases per-inference SynOps by 1.5-2.6x on three SNN models for the NMNIST, SHD, and IBM DVS Gesture datasets, while preserving the predicted class on at least 98% of evaluated samples. Second, to the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first universal sponge attack for native event-based SNN inputs: a fixed binary perturbation computed offline and applied via XOR to all subsequent inputs. Although weaker, it still inflates SynOps by 1.09-1.24x across all three datasets and represents a more realistic deployment threat because it requires no per-input optimization. Mapping SynOp inflation to estimated Loihi-1 energy yields per-inference overheads from 14 $μ$J to 13.24 mJ. These results show that native event-based SNNs are vulnerable to practical input-space efficiency attacks, and that reusable universal perturbations can accumulate into meaningful battery drain in continuously deployed edge systems.
2607.27990.paper_summary_zh: 尖峰神經網絡（SNNs）通過稀疏的二進制尖峰事件而非密集的激活進行通信，這使得在神經形態硬體上進行能量高效的推斷成為可能，並促使其在始終開啟的電池供電邊緣系統中的應用。我們表明，這種效率優勢帶來了一種明顯的安全風險：海綿攻擊可以增加推斷時的尖峰活動和突觸工作負載，從而增加能量消耗，同時僅通過基於正確性的監控仍然難以檢測。先前對SNNs的輸入空間效率攻擊主要集中在每個樣本的優化，主要是在速率編碼的設置中。我們將這一威脅擴展到原生事件驅動的二進制輸入，並研究兩種攻擊模型。首先，我們開發了一種每樣本海綿攻擊，通過基於梯度的優化為每個輸入製作自定義的對抗性尖峰列車。這種攻擊在NMNIST、SHD和IBM DVS Gesture數據集上的三個SNN模型中將每次推斷的SynOps增加了1.5-2.6倍，同時在至少98%的評估樣本中保留了預測類別。其次，據我們所知，我們引入了第一個針對原生事件驅動SNN輸入的通用海綿攻擊：一個離線計算的固定二進制擾動，通過XOR應用於所有後續輸入。儘管較弱，但它仍然在所有三個數據集上將SynOps增加了1.09-1.24倍，並且因為不需要每個輸入的優化，這代表了一種更現實的部署威脅。將SynOp的增加映射到估算的Loihi-1能量，顯示每次推斷的額外消耗從14 $μ$J到13.24 mJ不等。這些結果顯示，原生事件驅動的SNNs對實際的輸入空間效率攻擊是脆弱的，而可重複使用的通用擾動可以在持續部署的邊緣系統中累積成顯著的電池消耗。
2607.27990.author: Spyridon Raptis et.al.
